decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and creatures to put pressure on the opponent quickly. It includes efficient cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to dig for threats, along with disruption in the form of Daze and Force of Will to protect its creatures. Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early threats that can quickly close out the game, while Murktide Regent serves as a powerful finisher. Wasteland helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base, and Lightning Bolt provides additional reach or removal. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and aggressive in its gameplay.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic combined with aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Force of Negation. The inclusion of versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Fire/Ice provides additional interaction and versatility. The deck also features a Stompy element with the inclusion of Wasteland and aggressive creatures like Shardless Agent and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly establish board presence with aggressive creatures like Grief and Troll of Khazad-dûm, while disrupting the opponent with cards like Force of Will and Daze. The deck utilizes a tempo strategy, using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key pieces while maintaining control over the game. Reanimate provides a powerful reanimation option, while Wasteland helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain control throughout the game.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. By using these cards in combination with cards like Omniscience and Lotus Petal, the deck can bypass its high mana costs and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures. The deck also includes strong blue control elements like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to use the Bomberman combo, consisting of Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond, to generate infinite mana and then use that mana to win the game. The deck utilizes cards like Ancient Tomb, Lotus Petal, and Mox Opal to accelerate its mana production. It also includes Walking Ballista and Phyrexian Devourer as win conditions, allowing the deck to deal infinite damage or create a huge creature. The deck further incorporates disruption elements like Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator, and uses Urza's Saga to search for essential combo pieces.

The deck focuses on using the powerful card Doomsday to set up a winning combination quickly. It includes cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal to generate mana, as well as Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key cards. Force of Will and Veil of Summer are included for protection, while Teferi, Time Raveler helps to control the board. The win condition often involves using Thassa's Oracle or Lórien Revealed to win the game on the spot. Overall, the deck aims to combo off efficiently and secure a quick victory.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressively with low-cost creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes efficient card draw and manipulation with Ponder and Brainstorm, as well as disruption with Daze and Wasteland. Murktide Regent provides a big threat in the mid to late game. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure, control the game while keeping up the aggression, and finish off the opponent quickly.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan through aggressive play and disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Archon of Emeria. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game using efficient creatures and fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox. It also includes cards like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb to accelerate mana production. Overall, the deck focuses on executing a proactive game plan and maintaining tempo throughout the match.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Aluren to create a strong advantage. By casting Aluren, the player can then cast creatures with a converted mana cost of 3 or less for free, including Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath, Cavern Harpy, and Shardless Agent. This allows for powerful and efficient plays, while also utilizing cards like Living Wish and Endurance to search for specific creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes control elements and removal spells like Force of Will and Pernicious Deed to maintain board control and protect the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using disruptive cards like Stifle, Force of Will, and Dress Down while also utilizing the Dreadnought combo with Phyrexian Dreadnought and Torpor Orb. By preventing the opponent from executing their strategies and efficiently dealing with threats through cards like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, this deck aims to establish dominance on the battlefield while maintaining card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. Overall, the deck focuses on denying the opponent's resources and maintaining board control to secure the win.

This aggressive Dragon Stompy deck aims to disrupt opponent's strategy by dropping lock pieces like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Blood Moon early in the game while deploying threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers. The acceleration provided by cards like Chrome Mox, Ancient Tomb, and Simian Spirit Guide allows for quick and powerful plays. The deck's goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruptive elements and efficient beatdown creatures, backed up by powerful removal spells like Shatterskull Smashing and Fury.

The main focus of this Legacy Reanimator Combo deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Faithless Looting, Entomb, and Grief, and then bring them back into play with spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate. This allows for explosive plays and fast wins by utilizing powerful creatures earlier than they would normally be able to enter the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize, Unmask, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly through fast mana sources like Mox Opal, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond, and then chain together spell after spell to build up storm count. The deck aims to cast a storm spell like Tendrils of Agony or Galvanic Relay to finish off the opponent in one big turn. Using cards like Burning Wish and Beseech the Mirror, the deck can tutor for specific spells needed to win the game. The inclusion of Gaea's Will and Veil of Summer helps protect the combo from disruption.

This control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan using a combination of counter spells and removal, along with card draw and filtering to maintain consistency. The deck also includes creatures with powerful abilities to apply pressure on the opponent. The mana base is designed to ensure the deck has access to all necessary colors, while also including utility lands like Wasteland for added disruption. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through a mix of disruption, card advantage, and threats to secure victory.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Delver of Secrets to apply early pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruption spells such as Daze and Force of Will to control the board and protect its threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with cards like Wasteland to disrupt opponent's lands. Murktide Regent provides a powerful late-game threat, while cards like Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble help to filter through the deck and find key cards.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Paradigm Shift in combination with Thassa's Oracle to win the game by emptying the library. The deck is designed to control the game through counterspells like Force of Will and interaction cards like Swords to Plowshares. Teferi, Time Raveler and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade help with disruption and tempo plays. The mana base is set up to support the color requirements of the spells, with some utility lands like Cavern of Souls and Relic of Progenitus included to provide additional support and protection.
